caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a weather vane in the shape of a horse. The horse is rendered in a dark gray shade, with small circular details on its body suggesting rivets or joints. The horse is in profile, facing to the right, with one front leg raised and the other three legs on the ground. Its tail curves downward and to the left, and its ears are upright. The figure is mounted on a horizontal base, also shaded in dark gray, which has a lighter gray rod supporting the horse near its center. The drawing is composed on an off-white or cream-colored background, with a rectangular outline framing the image. The artist's name, "CARL WEISS," is written in small, uppercase letters in the upper left corner.
title: Horse Weather Vane
